candidate: ecoDC data centre (EcoDC E4; Evolution VN01 Hanoi), EcoDC Building, Hanoi Telecom High-Tech Complex (ICT Park), Lot E4, Km 27+300 Thang Long Avenue, Hoa Lac Hi-tech Park, Hanoi
decision: Selected the Google Maps feature 'EcoDC HITC', which carries the data centre's name, links its official site ecodc.vn and has the same ICT Park / Km27 Thang Long Boulevard address that the operator gives for the EcoDC Building; compiled reference, not a surveyed boundary.
coordinate_reference_system: WGS84 longitude/latitude as supplied in the Google Maps named-feature response; no transformation applied
precision_scope: Google feature named after the ecoDC data centre (listing category 'Corporate office') at ICT Park, Km27 Thang Long Boulevard, Hoa Lac. The operator gives the EcoDC Building on Lot E4 of the Hanoi Telecom High-Tech Complex as its only address, so the point is read as the ecoDC building complex on the 4.47 ha Lot E4. It is not a surveyed footprint, the lot boundary or an entrance, and does not separate Evolution's VN01 halls from the rest of the building.
horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: The map feature does not publish a surveyed horizontal accuracy; the 'ICT Park' complex feature lies 0.22 km to the north, so the point locates the complex rather than a measured building centroid.
feature_address: ICT Park, Km27 Thang Long Boulevard, Hòa Lạc, Hà Nội, Vietnam

repeat_query.note: An earlier query ('EcoDC Hoa Lac Hi-tech Park data center') returned the same feature id and coordinates as its second result, after the separate Viettel IDC Hoa Lac data centre.

excluded_coordinates.reason: Google default request viewport; no candidate coordinates were inserted into the query.
'ICT Park' (Hanoi Telecom) research-institute feature for the wider complex, 0.22 km away; the data-centre-named feature was preferred.
'Data Center Viettel IDC Hòa Lạc', a different operator's data centre about 1.7 km north-west.
'Hoa Lac High-tech Park' technology-park feature; an estate-level point, not the facility.

capture_link_chain.response_origin: The search response URL was read from a link in the captured Google Maps HTML; no candidate coordinates were inserted into the query.
capture_link_chain.method: Direct credential-free HTTP captures of public pages and their observed response link (robots.txt allows /maps?q= and /search?*tbm=map).

identity_bridge: Evolution's markets page (version modified 1 August 2026) lists VN01 Hanoi, 4.75 MW IT, 'RFS: In Operation', located at 'EcoDC E4 within Hoa Lac Hi-tech Park, Thach That District, Hanoi', partner HITC.

The ecoDC site says ecoDC is built on Lot E4 of Hoa Lac Hi-tech Park (4.47 ha) and gives its address as the EcoDC Building, Hanoi Telecom High-Tech Complex, ICT Park, Lot E4 - Km 27+300, Thang Long Avenue; its history page names HTC International Telecommunication JSC (HTC-ITC) as the company that contracted its construction in 2019, with Uptime Tier III design and constructed-facility certification in 2020.
The selected feature is named 'EcoDC HITC', links ecodc.vn and has the address ICT Park, Km27 Thang Long Boulevard, Hoa Lac, matching the operator's contact address for the EcoDC Building.
consistency_checks: Distinct name collision: EcoDataCenter (EcoDC) in Sweden, a pending nordics-p1 candidate, is an unrelated company.
The feature lies about 3.2 km south-east of the Hoa Lac High-tech Park feature, inside the park's eastern sector along Thang Long Avenue at about Km 27; consistent with the stated Km 27+300 address.
